_doc: Default classes (GDD 6). 'best:<type>' picks the best unlocked tier of a tiered weapon type; 'best:<armour class>' the best unlocked full set; 'best:<armour class>:<slot>' one piece. Default classes upgrade on their own.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.desc: Melee tank. Scimitar and plate, lots of food.

archer.name: Archer
archer.desc: Ranged kiter. Shortbow and hides, strong against mages.

battlemage.name: Battlemage
battlemage.desc: Freeze them, then switch to the scimitar.

tribrid.name: Tribrid
tribrid.desc: All three styles. Fewer supplies, more mind games.

supply_packs._doc: Supplies per life. main_food_scale multiplies the class's main food (so inventory budget still matters); Extra Rations adds the pack's extra_rations main food on top (+3 in full packs). Tuned with tools/balance_sim.gd.
